description: Generalize torn-sack spilling so every current child object leaves the sack instead of only the canonical lunch and garlic

replacements.new:
<ROUTINE NARRATIVE-SPILL-SACK-CONTENTS ("AUX" X NXT)
    <COND (<SET X <FIRST? ,SANDWICH-BAG>>
           <REPEAT ()
              <SET NXT <NEXT? .X>>
              <MOVE .X ,HERE>
              <COND (<NOT .NXT> <RETURN>)>
              <SET X .NXT>>)>
    <RTRUE>>
